question: Mount Jopuno is situated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mount Jopuno**__

 __
 
• **Mount Jopuno is situated in the western part of Sikkim at an elevation of 5603 meters.**
 
• It lies under the **Kanchenjunga National Park.**
 
 
 
• **Sikkim**__
 
 
• **Capital:** Gangtok
 
• **Chief Minister:** Prem Singh Tamang (As of March 2022).
 
• **Governor: **Ganga Prasad (As of March 2022).
 
• **National Parks:** Kanchenjunga National Park
 
• **Important Peaks: **Mt. Kanchenjunga, Mt. Kabru, Mt. Talung, Mt. Simvo, Mt. Rathong, Mt. Kabru Dome, Mt. Kokthang, Mt. Pandim
 
• **State Animal:** Red Panda
 
• **State Bird:** Blood Pheasant
 
• **State Tree:** Rhododen Dron
 
• **State Flower:** Noble Dendrobium
